provenance_quote: The ShlA hemolysin of Serratia marcescens is secreted across the outer membrane by the ShlB protein; ShlB belongs to the two-partner secretion system (type Vb), a subfamily of the Omp85 outer membrane protein assembly and secretion superfamily.
notes: DOI 10.1016/j.ijmm.2013.11.021 = PMID 24462008 (Pramanik 2014 IJMM); quote verbatim from abstract. UniProt P15320 = ShlA hemolysin, Serratia marcescens, TPS/FhaB-like domain, requires ShlB. T5bSS secreted partner = ShlA itself. Identity fields correct.

provenance_quote: NadA has a predicted molecular structure strikingly similar to a novel class of adhesins (YadA and UspA2), forms high molecular weight oligomers, and binds to epithelial cells in vitro
notes: Crossref confirms DOI 10.1084/jem.20020407 = Comanducci 2002 JEM NadA novel vaccine candidate of N. meningitidis. UniProt Q9JXK7 = NadA, N. meningitidis MC58, trimeric autotransporter (AT-2), passenger translocated to surface; T5cSS substrate = NadA itself. Identity fields correct.

provenance_quote: an N-terminal oval head domain is followed by a putative coiled-coil rod and terminated by a C-terminal membrane anchor domain.
notes: Crossref confirms DOI = Hoiczyk 2000 EMBO J on YadA/UspA structure (trimeric autotransporter adhesins). UniProt A1JUB7 = YadA, Y. enterocolitica 8081, Type V autotransporter AT-2, passenger translocated to surface; T5cSS substrate = YadA itself. Identity fields correct.

provenance_quote: We discovered a novel secreted protein by Pseudomonas aeruginosa, PlpD ... The association between a TpsB component and a passenger protein is a unique hybrid organization that we propose to classify as Type Vd.
notes: Crossref confirms DOI = Salacha 2010 Environ Microbiol, PlpD archetype of novel Type V (Vd) secretion. UniProt Q9HYQ6 = PlpD, plpD, PA3339, P. aeruginosa PAO1, GO type V secretion, Omp85/TpsB transporter family. T5dSS is a published subtype; passenger (patatin) is the secreted substrate. Identity fields correct.
